schema:name: Coffee Fermentation Bin, Jardin, Colombia
schema:description: This image depicts an outdoor concrete coffee fermentation tank against a hillside in Jardin, Colombia.  Hacienda La Minita, Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, maintains relationships with specialty coffee producers, millers, and exporters around the world. In Jardín, Colombia, Hacienda La Minita works directly with coffee producers through purchasing and quality programs and processes regional coffees through its milling operation in Jardín, where coffees are prepared for export.
